{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: E2E Tests

permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "Clients/**"
      - "Servers/**"
      - ".github/workflows/e2e-tests.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      only_last_failed:
        description: "Only re-run tests that failed in the previous workflow run"
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

jobs:
  e2e-tests:
    name: Playwright E2E Tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ matrix.total }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    # Each shard is its own job with its own Postgres and Redis, so tests that
    # depend on earlier tests' data still run in order within a shard and
    # cannot see another shard's data. Playwright runs the setup projects a
    # shard's tests depend on inside that shard.
    #
    # Each shard spends ~3 minutes on setup before its first test, so beyond
    # about 5 shards the setup dominates and more shards barely help.
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        total: [5]

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: verifywise_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          # jsdom 30.x (used by Servers) requires Node >= 22.22.2.
          node-version: '22'
          # Caches npm's download cache (not node_modules), keyed on both lockfiles.
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            Servers/package-lock.json
            Clients/package-lock.json

      # ---- Backend setup ----
      - name: Install backend dependencies
        working-directory: Servers
        run: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps

      - name: Build backend
        working-directory: Servers
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run migrations
        working-directory: Servers
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_NAME: verifywise_test
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          # Required by the RLS runtime-role migration (rls-app-role.js), which
          # fails closed without it. CI-only value; not a real credential.
          DB_APP_PASSWORD: test-app-role-password-for-ci
          SUPERADMIN_EMAIL: admin@verifywise-test.com
          SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD: TestAdmin!Str0ng
        run: npx sequelize db:migrate

      - name: Seed test data
        working-directory: Servers
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_NAME: verifywise_test
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          # Re-create/refresh the super-admin so E2E login credentials are always valid.
          SUPERADMIN_EMAIL: admin@verifywise-test.com
          SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD: TestAdmin!Str0ng
        run: node dist/scripts/seedTestData.js

      # ---- AIGateway setup ----
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: AIGateway/requirements.txt

      - name: Install AIGateway dependencies
        working-directory: AIGateway
        run: |
          # presidio-anonymizer 2.2.364 caps cryptography<49.0.0, but VerifyWise requires >=50.0.0.
          # Install presidio-anonymizer without deps; its only required dependency is cryptography,
          # which is already declared in requirements.txt.
          grep -v '^presidio-anonymizer' requirements.txt > /tmp/requirements-install.txt
          pip install -r /tmp/requirements-install.txt
          pip install --no-deps "$(grep '^presidio-anonymizer' requirements.txt)"

      - name: Start AIGateway
        working-directory: AIGateway/src
        env:
          AI_GATEWAY_PORT: 8100
          AI_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_KEY: test-ai-gateway-key-for-e2e
          REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_NAME: verifywise_test
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          ENCRYPTION_KEY: test-encryption-key-32chars!!
          EXPRESS_BACKEND_URL: http://localhost:3000
        run: |
          alembic upgrade head
          uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8100 > /tmp/aigateway.log 2>&1 &
          # Wait for AIGateway to be ready
          AIGATEWAY_READY=false
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8100/health || true)
            echo "AIGateway health check attempt $i: HTTP $HTTP_STATUS"
            if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "200" ]; then
              echo "AIGateway is ready"
              AIGATEWAY_READY=true
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$AIGATEWAY_READY" != "true" ]; then
            echo "AIGateway did not become ready; tailing logs..."
            tail -n 100 /tmp/aigateway.log || true
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Start backend
        working-directory: Servers
        env:
          PORT: 3000
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_NAME: verifywise_test
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          JWT_SECRET: test-jwt-secret-for-e2e
          REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET: test-refresh-secret-for-e2e
          ENCRYPTION_KEY: test-encryption-key-32chars!!
          MULTI_TENANCY_ENABLED: false
          AI_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8100
          AI_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_KEY: test-ai-gateway-key-for-e2e
        run: |
          node dist/index.js > /tmp/backend.log 2>&1 &
          # Report generation and other queued jobs run on the BullMQ worker, a separate process
          node dist/jobs/worker.js > /tmp/worker.log 2>&1 &
          # Wait for backend to be ready
          BACKEND_READY=false
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/api/users/check/exists || true)
            echo "Backend health check attempt $i: HTTP $HTTP_STATUS"
            if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "200" ] || [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "400" ] || [ "$HTTP_STATUS" = "401" ]; then
              echo "Backend is responding (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
              BACKEND_READY=true
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$BACKEND_READY" != "true" ]; then
            echo "Backend did not become ready; tailing logs..."
            tail -n 100 /tmp/backend.log || true
            exit 1
          fi

      # ---- Frontend setup ----
      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        working-directory: Clients
        run: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps

      - name: Cache Playwright browsers
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: playwright-browsers-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('Clients/package-lock.json', 'Clients/package.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            playwright-browsers-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        working-directory: Clients
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Start frontend
        working-directory: Clients
        env:
          VITE_APP_API_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000
        run: |
          npm run dev:vite &
          # Wait for frontend to be ready
          FRONTEND_READY=false
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5173 >/dev/null; then
              echo "Frontend is ready"
              FRONTEND_READY=true
              break
            fi
            echo "Frontend health check attempt $i"
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$FRONTEND_READY" != "true" ]; then
            echo "Frontend did not become ready"
            exit 1
          fi

      # ---- Smoke test backend login before Playwright ----
      - name: Smoke test backend login
        run: |
          echo "Smoke testing backend login endpoint..."
          LOGIN_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/users/login \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"email":"admin@verifywise-test.com","password":"TestAdmin!Str0ng"}' \
            -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}\n")
          echo "$LOGIN_RESPONSE"
          LOGIN_STATUS=$(echo "$LOGIN_RESPONSE" | tail -n 1 | sed 's/HTTP_STATUS://')
          if [ "$LOGIN_STATUS" != "202" ]; then
            echo "Login smoke test failed with HTTP $LOGIN_STATUS; tailing backend logs..."
            tail -n 100 /tmp/backend.log || true
            exit 1
          fi

      # ---- Run E2E tests ----
      # Persist Playwright's last-run metadata across workflow runs so a push
      # that targets a previously-failing test can start with just that test
      # instead of waiting for the whole suite.
      #
      # To only re-run previously failing tests, either:
      #  - trigger the workflow manually with only_last_failed=true, or
      #  - include "[e2e-only-failed]" in the HEAD commit message.
      - name: Determine test mode
        id: test_mode
        run: |
          HEAD_MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=%B)
          if [[ "$HEAD_MSG" == *"[e2e-only-failed]"* ]] || [[ "${{ inputs.only_last_failed }}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "only_last_failed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "only_last_failed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Restore last-run metadata
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v6
        with:
          path: Clients/test-results/.last-run.json
          key: playwright-last-run-${{ github.ref }}-shard${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: |
            playwright-last-run-${{ github.ref }}-shard${{ matrix.shard }}-

      - name: Run previously failed E2E tests
        working-directory: Clients
        env:
          E2E_BASE_URL: http://localhost:5173
          E2E_EMAIL: admin@verifywise-test.com
          E2E_PASSWORD: TestAdmin!Str0ng
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_NAME: verifywise_test
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
        run: |
          if [ -f test-results/.last-run.json ]; then
            FAILED_COUNT=$(jq '.failedTestIds | length' test-results/.last-run.json)
            if [ "$FAILED_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
              echo "Re-running $FAILED_COUNT previously failed test(s)"
              npx playwright test --last-failed
            else
              echo "No previously failed tests; skipping last-failed step."
            fi
          else
            echo "No previous run metadata found; skipping last-failed step."
          fi

      - name: Run full E2E test suite
        if: ${{ steps.test_mode.outputs.only_last_failed != 'true' }}
        working-directory: Clients
        env:
          E2E_BASE_URL: http://localhost:5173
          # Must match the super-admin seeded by the migration step, otherwise
          # global.setup logs in as a non-super-admin and the flow cannot create
          # organizations. seedE2EAdmin (spawned by global.setup) also needs the
          # DB_* vars to connect, since there is no Servers/.env in CI.
          E2E_EMAIL: admin@verifywise-test.com
          E2E_PASSWORD: TestAdmin!Str0ng
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_NAME: verifywise_test
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
        run: npx playwright test --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ matrix.total }}

      - name: Save last-run metadata
        if: always()
        uses: actions/cache/save@v6
        with:
          path: Clients/test-results/.last-run.json
          key: playwright-last-run-${{ github.ref }}-shard${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: playwright-report-shard${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: Clients/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 14

      # One JSON file per scanned page, written by e2e/helpers/axe.ts as each
      # scan runs. It records the rules that were disabled, and why, alongside
      # the results — a report claiming zero violations is only meaningful next
      # to the list of what was not checked. Written directly by the helper
      # rather than by a reporter, so it exists whatever the reporter config is.
      - name: Upload accessibility report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: accessibility-report-shard${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: Clients/accessibility-report/
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: playwright-results-shard${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: Clients/test-results/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload backend logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: backend-logs-shard${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: |
            /tmp/backend.log
            /tmp/worker.log
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload AIGateway logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: aigateway-logs-shard${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: /tmp/aigateway.log
          retention-days: 7",
  "rationale": "The E2E Tests workflow runs a 5-shard matrix with fail-fast: false, so every shard continues running even after one fails. Evidence: P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (matrix cancellation saves remaining work).",

}
